context.content_translation:
花艺工作坊将在大型会议室举行，前提是到 5 月 1 日截止日期前有超过 30 人注册。
A. at
B. if
C. even
D. instead

items.question: The flower-arranging workshop will be held in the large meeting room ------ over 30 people register by the May 1 deadline.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“if”代入题干后为“The flower-arranging workshop will be held in the large meeting room if over 30 people register by the May 1 deadline.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：B（if）。
